scope: Isolated raw typed evaluator on macOS ARM64 with the pinned DuckDB 2.0.0 Node SDK

first_run.wrapper_issue: The zsh wrapper attempted to assign reserved status after Node completed.

coverage: Four raw JSON/blob tests cover exact source byte identity and grouping, opaque blob IDs, scoped strict syntax/depth/width, tag masks, eager operator and aggregate rejection, and actual compatibility carriers.
Six preexisting datetime/reference tests exercise exact six-tag behavior, four-tag compatibility, audited persisted query lowering and controlled template generation.
scope_limits: This isolated build changes raw evaluator admission only. Persisted JSON/blob reads and writes remain outside the qualification.
